# Implementation Plan: Genericize SpecKit and Claude Code Configuration for Cross-Project Reuse

**Branch**: `001-generic-speckit-reuse` | **Date**: 2026-01-27 | **Spec**: `specs/001-generic-speckit-reuse/spec.md`
**Input**: Feature specification from `specs/001-generic-speckit-reuse/spec.md`

## Summary

Refactor all SpecKit and Claude Code configuration files to separate core workflow (generic, portable) from technology-specific (.NET) and domain-specific (BreezSDK, Umbraco) content. Core files become reusable across any project. Technology and domain content moves to a project-specific addendum file (`CLAUDE.project.md`) and remains as optional extensions.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: N/A — This is a configuration refactoring feature (Markdown, JSON, PowerShell files only)
**Primary Dependencies**: Claude Code 2.1.19, SpecKit workflow
**Storage**: N/A (file-based configuration)
**Testing**: Content validation (grep-based verification of domain term absence in core files)
**Target Platform**: Any project using Claude Code + SpecKit
**Project Type**: Configuration toolkit
**Performance Goals**: N/A
**Constraints**: No regression in SpecKit workflow effectiveness; all existing capabilities preserved
**Scale/Scope**: ~30 files to review/modify, ~15 files requiring changes

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| Article | Principle | Status | Notes |
|---------|-----------|--------|-------|
| I.1 | Clean Architecture Mandate | N/A | No runtime code; configuration files only |
| I.3 | Modular Decomposition | PASS | Three-tier separation (Core → Technology Profile → Domain Extensions) is modular by design |
| II.4 | Self-Documenting Code | PASS | File taxonomy is clear; CLAUDE.project.md is self-explanatory |
| III.1 | Test-First Imperative | DEVIATION | No runtime code to TDD; verification is content validation via grep |
| IX.1 | YAGNI Enforcement | PASS | Only separating what's currently mixed; no speculative generalization |
| IX.2 | Maximum Project Limit | N/A | No new projects |
| IX.3 | Dependency Scrutiny | PASS | No new dependencies |
| XII.1 | Task Independence | PASS | Most file changes are independent and parallelizable |
| XIII.1 | Constitution Supremacy | PASS | Constitution itself will be genericized per this plan |

**Deviation: III.1 (Test-First)**:
- **Rationale**: This feature modifies configuration files (Markdown, JSON), not runtime code. TDD is not applicable. Verification is done via content scanning (grep for domain terms in core files).
- **Risk acceptance**: Low risk — changes are to documentation and configuration, not executable code.
- **Remediation**: Validation script will verify all success criteria post-implementation.

**Post-Design Re-Check**: All gates pass. The three-tier file taxonomy maintains clean separation. Constitution genericization preserves all principles.

## Design Decisions

### D1: CLAUDE.md Split Strategy

**Current state**: Single `CLAUDE.md` (~400 lines) with interspersed .NET, BreezSDK, and Umbraco content.

**Target state**:
- `CLAUDE.md` (~250 lines): SpecKit workflow, generic agents table, wave execution, context management, checkpoint patterns. Technology-specific sections replaced with generic equivalents or references to `CLAUDE.project.md`.
- `CLAUDE.project.md` (~200 lines): .NET conventions, .NET build/test commands, domain agent tables, MCP server documentation, technology-specific test patterns, gotchas.

**Content migration map**:

| Section in current CLAUDE.md | Target File | Action |
|------------------------------|-------------|--------|
| Project Configuration header | CLAUDE.md | Keep, genericize |
| Governance | CLAUDE.md | Keep as-is |
| Spec-Kit Workflow Order | CLAUDE.md | Keep as-is (already generic) |
| .NET Commands table | CLAUDE.project.md | Move |
| Frontend Commands table | CLAUDE.project.md | Move |
| Code Conventions (.NET Style) | CLAUDE.project.md | Move |
| Database (EF Core) | CLAUDE.project.md | Move |
| API Design | CLAUDE.md | Keep (generic REST principles) |
| Common .NET Gotchas | CLAUDE.project.md | Move |
| Available Agents (core) | CLAUDE.md | Keep (7 core agents only) |
| Available Agents (domain) | CLAUDE.project.md | Move (breezsdk-*, umbraco-*) |
| Agent Tools & Permissions (core) | CLAUDE.md | Keep (7 core agents only) |
| Agent Tools & Permissions (domain) | CLAUDE.project.md | Move |
| Agent & Plugin Utilization | CLAUDE.md | Keep, remove domain agents from table |
| Wave Execution Strategy | CLAUDE.md | Keep, genericize build/test commands |
| Test Timing Guidelines | CLAUDE.project.md | Move (.NET-specific Polly patterns) |
| Static State in Tests | CLAUDE.project.md | Move (.NET-specific Meter patterns) |
| Workflow Rules | CLAUDE.md | Keep, genericize tool commands |
| Branch Strategy | CLAUDE.md | Keep (already generic) |
| Resources | CLAUDE.md | Keep, update references |

### D2: hooks.json Genericization

**SessionStart hook**: Remove domain agent names from agent list. List only core agents.

**UserPromptSubmit hook**: Remove `dotnet-implementation-execution.md` skill reference (renamed). Use `implementation-execution.md`. Remove `dotnet-claude-code-skills` from skill context.

**PostToolUse (Write|Edit) hook**: Make file extension patterns generic. Change `.cs|.razor` to a comment-documented customizable pattern. Remove `dotnet format` call as default. Replace with generic format-check message.

**PostToolUse (Bash) hook**: Make build/test detection generic. Change `dotnet test` and `dotnet build` to generic pattern matching.

**Stop hook**: Remove `.cs` file detection. Use generic "uncommitted source files" detection.

**SubagentStart hook**: Remove .NET-specific agent guidance. Use generic role descriptions.

**PreToolUse (Write|Edit) hook**: Change `.csproj` detection to generic project file detection.

### D3: Constitution Genericization

**Title**: ".NET Fullstack Development Constitution" → "Software Development Constitution"

**Preamble**: Remove ".NET fullstack development project" → "software development project"

**Enforcement mechanisms**: Replace `dotnet build`, `dotnet test`, `dotnet format` with generic "build tool", "test runner", "formatter" throughout. Keep the principle statements unchanged (they're already universal).

**Enforcement Framework section**: Replace hardcoded `dotnet` commands with generic `<build-tool>`, `<test-runner>`, `<formatter>` placeholders.

### D4: Core Agent Genericization

Each of the 7 core agents needs technology-specific terms replaced with generic equivalents:

| Agent | Remove | Replace With |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| solution-architect | .NET, Clean Architecture (keep as pattern name) | Generic architecture patterns |
| backend-developer | C# 12+, ASP.NET Core, EF Core | Backend development, ORM, web framework |
| frontend-developer | Blazor, Razor | Component framework, templates |
| test-engineer | xUnit, FluentAssertions, Moq | Test framework, assertion library, mocking framework |
| database-architect | EF Core, SQL Server | ORM, relational database |
| security-auditor | .NET security patterns | Generic security patterns |
| code-reviewer | .NET conventions | Project conventions (per CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.project.md) |

**Generic Example Guidelines (FR-016)**:

When replacing domain-specific examples in core agents, use technology-neutral domain concepts:

| Instead of (domain-specific) | Use (generic) |
|------------------------------|--------------|
| `BreezPaymentService`, `InvoiceEntity` | `OrderService`, `UserEntity` |
| `LightningPaymentFlow` | `PaymentFlow` or `CheckoutFlow` |
| `UmbracoDocumentType`, `ContentNode` | `ContentType`, `PageModel` |
| `Sats`, `BOLT11 invoice` | `Amount`, `transaction reference` |
| `.cs` file examples | Language-neutral pseudocode or `<source-file>` placeholder |

Agents should illustrate universal patterns (SRP, repository, factory, observer) using generic entities (User, Product, Order, Notification) rather than any specific business domain.

### D5: speckit.implement.md Genericization

- Replace `dotnet build`, `dotnet test`, `dotnet format` with generic build/test/format references
- Replace `dotnet-claude-code-skills` plugin reference with generic note about technology-specific plugins
- Keep all workflow patterns (waves, checkpoints, TDD, quality gates) unchanged
- Keep agent recommendation table (uses core agents only)
- Replace `.NET projects` language with generic "projects" or "the project"

### D6: Skills Genericization

- Rename `dotnet-implementation-execution.md` → `implementation-execution.md`
- Replace `dotnet build/test/format` commands with generic build/test/format references
- Keep wave execution patterns, checkpoint strategy, context management unchanged
- In `external-plugins.md`: replace constitution article number references with principle name references

### D7: Customizable Section Markup Standard

Files containing technology-specific content that remains in core files (as customizable examples rather than moved to `CLAUDE.project.md`) MUST use this markup convention:

**For Markdown files** (CLAUDE.md, constitution.md, agent .md files):
- Wrap customizable sections with HTML comments:
  ```markdown
  <!-- CUSTOMIZABLE: Replace with your project's technology stack -->
  ### Build Commands
  | Action | Command |
  |--------|---------|
  | Build  | `<build-tool> build` |
  | Test   | `<test-runner>` |
  <!-- END CUSTOMIZABLE -->
  ```

**For JSON files** (hooks.json, settings.json):
- Use descriptive key names with `_comment` fields:
  ```json
  {
    "_comment_filePatterns": "CUSTOMIZABLE: Replace extensions with your project's source file types",
    "filePatterns": "\\.(js|ts|py)$"
  }
  ```

**Rationale**: Consistent markers allow automated tooling (future validation scripts) to identify customizable sections and allow developers to quickly locate what needs project-specific adjustment.
